python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import zipfile

SRC, DST = 'sales_data.xlsx', 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
sheet = zin.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode()
styles = zin.read('xl/styles.xml').decode()

# 1) Extend dimension to include column H
sheet = sheet.replace('<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>')

# 2) Add column width definition for H
sheet = sheet.replace('</cols>', '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>')

# 3) Add header H1 (matches existing header style s="1")
old_hdr = '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>'
new_hdr = old_hdr[:-6] + '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin</t></is></c></row>'
assert old_hdr in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old_hdr, new_hdr)

# 4) Add formula cells H2:H10 (s="3" percent; s="4" bold percent for total)
for r in range(2, 10):
    old = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    new = old[:-6] + f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    assert old in sheet, f'missing row {r}'
    sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

old10 = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>'
new10 = old10[:-6] + '<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c></row>'
assert old10 in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old10, new10)

# 5) Add 0.0% number format to styles.xml
styles = styles.replace('<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>')
styles = styles.replace('<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="5">')
styles = styles.replace('</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
    '</cellXfs>')

# 6) Write new workbook, preserving everything else
with zipfile.ZipFile(DST, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            data = sheet.encode()
        elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = styles.encode()
        zout.writestr(item, data)
zin.close()

print('Wrote', DST)
PYEOF

import zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data_new.xlsx')
sheet = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode()
styles = z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode()

# Show the new H cells
import re
print("--- Column H cells ---")
for m in re.finditer(r'<c r="H\d+".*?</c>', sheet):
    print(m.group(0))
print("--- Dimension:", re.search(r'<dimension ref="[^"]*"/>', sheet).group(0))
print("--- Cols:", re.search(r'<cols>.*?</cols>', sheet).group(0)[:300])
print("--- numFmts:", re.search(r'<numFmts.*?</numFmts>', styles).group(0))
print("--- cellXfs count:", re.search(r'<cellXfs count="\d+">', styles).group(0))

# Expected values check (data rows)
data = [
    (150, 25, 15), (200, 25, 15), (75, 45, 28), (120, 45, 28),
    (50, 99, 55), (85, 99, 55), (30, 199, 50), (45, 199, 50),
]
print("\n--- Expected margins (profit = units*price - units*cost; margin = profit/revenue) ---")
tot_rev = tot_profit = 0
for u, p, c in data:
    rev, cost = u * p, u * c
    profit = rev - cost
    tot_rev += rev; tot_profit += profit
    print(f"units={u:4d} price={p:3d} cost={c:3d} -> revenue={rev:6d} profit={profit:6d} margin={profit/rev:6.3f}")
print(f"TOTAL -> revenue={tot_rev} profit={tot_profit} margin={tot_profit/tot_rev:.3f}")
PYEOF
